eligibility: At least 3 average active listings per observed week and at least one usable group median.
print_selection: Four largest classes by listing-weeks; up to ten eligible areas per class selected by average observed inventory, ordered by city and price.

definitions.mean_group_median_ngn: Unweighted mean of usable weekly area/class group medians, converted from kobo to NGN. Not a pooled listing-level median or valuation.
definitions.average_active_per_observed_week: Summed active listing counts divided by weeks observed for this area/class; rounded to one decimal.
definitions.observed_weeks: Distinct week starts with a source row for this area/class.
definitions.priced_weeks: Distinct week starts with a usable positive finite median price.
definitions.report_weeks: Included week starts for the whole market, after the metrics coverage filter.
definitions.listing_weeks: Sum of weekly active counts; properties may recur in several weeks.
definitions.rental_period: Annual asking rents are assumed from the source, not independently verified.

limitations: Reconstructed historical prices reuse current listing records.
Broad classes do not control for size, bedrooms, condition or tenure.
Portal coverage is not representative of national stock or completed transactions.
spreadsheet_text: Potential formula text is prefixed with an apostrophe in CSV downloads.
